triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '3. Keeping stale scale-factor layout conversion' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 3. Keeping stale scale-factor layout conversion

problem.statement: SM120 NVFP4 Decode GEMM Production Pitfalls -- 3. Keeping stale scale-factor layout conversion

payload.attempted: Reuse the old CUTLASS-to-ATREX scale conversion after swapping the NVFP4 GEMV binary.
payload.lesson: Every binary swap needs a layout sanity test and a recorded kernel identity. Do not assume scale-layout compatibility from matching tensor shapes.

established_fact.mechanism: FP4 scale-factor layout is part of the kernel ABI. It can change independently from payload layout.

payload.observed: The accepted CUDA Split-K binary consumed CUTLASS-swizzled `SF_B` directly, so the older conversion became wrong even though A/B packed data layout looked unchanged.
payload.root_cause: FP4 scale-factor layout is part of the kernel ABI. It can change independently from payload layout.
